Alex — thanks for the great questions. Quick answers inline, and Marissa will add technical confirmation in the next message.

1) Hosted keys: by default we use Redwood-managed KEKs in a multi-tenant key management layer. We offer dedicated key rings and isolated tenancy options in our Dedicated offering (we can scope this for you).
2) Dedicated / Private: customer-managed keys are supported. For Dedicated we integrate with customer KMS (e.g., AWS KMS) and can accept an ARN so the KEK is in your control — keys are not exported out of your KMS. For Private (on-prem) deployments we can wire in your HSM (PKCS#11 or vendor API) so keys live in your appliance.
3) HSM support: common HSMs (AWS CloudHSM via AWS KMS, Thales/vault HSM integrations) are supported in Private deployments. We can share our HSM integration matrix during the deep-dive.
4) Auditability: we emit detailed request logs — access and key-unwrap events are logged. For Dedicated/Private we can route logs to your SIEM (CloudWatch/CloudTrail/Splunk). For hosted we provide summarized audit logs and can surface per-customer events upon request.
5) BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA for customers handling PHI; we have existing BAAs with other customers. We will coordinate legal — DocuSign link available once scope is finalized.

Hi Alex / Priya — adding a few technical specifics to Camila’s helpful summary: 

- Encryption model: we use envelope encryption. Customer data is encrypted with a data encryption key (DEK) generated per-blob/session; the DEK is encrypted (wrapped) with a key-encryption-key (KEK) that is stored in KMS (customer-provided for CMEK, or Redwood-managed for default). DEKs are ephemeral; KEKs are subject to rotation policies.
- Key custody: For CMEK (Dedicated/Private), KEKs stay in your KMS/HSM and we call KMS APIs to perform unwrap/cryptographic operations. We do not export or persist raw KEK material.
- HSM attestation: When using HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM/Thales), we can provide configuration docs and attestations for the environment (customer/provisioned HSM depending on deployment).
- Audit logs: KMS unwrap/usage events are available via your cloud audit trail (CloudTrail) and we additionally emit our application-level audit events. We can centralize logs to your SIEM (recommended for Dedicated/Private).
- Multi-tenant isolation: in hosted plans we isolate data per-tenant logically; for strict key isolation we recommend Dedicated with dedicated key rings (we can scope a PoC).
- HIPAA: BAA is supported. Technical controls (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, logging) align with HIPAA expectations — legal will follow up on DocuSign.

Next steps (technical team):
1) Camila to schedule deep-dive — I’ll prepare an architecture deck and the HSM integration matrix.
2) Once we confirm the deployment option (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), we’ll provide a CMEK implementation doc and a sample KMS policy for FinBank to review.
3) I can start filling items in your security questionnaire and return the XLSX with redlines prior to the call.
